name: Thancred Waters
oracle_text:
Flash
Royal Guard — When Thancred Waters enters, another target legendary permanent you control gains indestructible for as long as you control Thancred Waters.
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, Thancred Waters gains indestructible until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Royal Guard — When Thancred Waters enters, another target legendary permanent you control gains indestructible for as long as you control Thancred Waters.

needs.what: a duration for one-shot grants (grant_keyword, and by extension pump/animate) meaning 'for as long as you control <source>': the effect written onto the targeted permanent ends the moment the source leaves the battlefield or changes controller (611.2b)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_keyword's duration takes only until_end_of_turn, until_your_next_turn and permanent; permanent outlives Thancred leaving, the timed ones end too early. A grant_keyword static ends with its source but its affects filter has no key binding it to the one permanent the enters trigger targeted (only attached/paired_with_source/enchanted_by), so it cannot mean 'that target'.
